text:
Travis Konecny has spent 740 NHL games in a Flyers sweater, and this month the question is whether there will be many more. Several outlets reported that Philadelphia is willing to listen to trade calls on him (Markerzone this week, with Montreal floated as a fit earlier), and Yahoo Sports ran a piece arguing he shouldn't have to answer questions about his commitment to the Flyers and their youth.

He has answered on the ice. Kevin Kurz noted that Konecny seemed eager to talk to the media the morning of the Ottawa game, then had his best night of the season, four points in a comeback win. He has eight points in his last ten, right where our expectation sits.

The underlying picture is a useful middle-six winger more than a star: 13 points in 17 games, about 0.9 expected goals per 60 on his own shots, the same as last season, and Evolving-Hockey had him 264th of 401 forwards in value last season, dragged down by what he gave up defensively. He also throws hits, 52 already. For a buyer, that is the profile: energy, a little finish, a lot of noise.
